stories.headline: Dialog Claims It Was Hacked. A Misconfigured Website Left Its Members Exposed
stories.dek: The private events group, cofounded by Peter Thiel, says a “criminal” hacker is behind a breach that exposed members’ personal details. WIRED found no evidence a break-in was needed to access the files.

stories.headline: The best robot vacuum deals available during Prime Day

Prime Day has kicked off, though more than just Amazon is offering deals on several models we’ve tested from brands like Roborock, Dreame, and Shark.
